New keys arrive through a sponsor holding standing for six epochs. That sponsor locks 300 POA against the applicant, backing one key per ten epochs; a key flagged in a farm costs the sponsor 100 POA and the slot.

Fifty clones need fifty established sponsors and 15,000 POA locked. Costs spiral: each volunteer gives up sixty hours, and one cluster check puts 5,000 POA at risk. Vouching links are public, so fifty applicants tracing back to two wallets look like bare copper wiring on the audit page.

A meadow shares one root network, yet each stem still needs its own square of light.
